argv:
set -uo pipefail
n=0
local_i=0
while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  case "$f" in
    scripts/test-wull-manual-perimeter.py|scripts/test-megaqml-host-ui-fixture.py|scripts/test-megaqml-ui-fixture.py|scripts/test-megaqml-qt-diagnostic.py|scripts/test-megaqml-quickshell-classify.py|scripts/test-megaqml-phase2p-history-guard.py) continue ;;
  esac
  if (( n >= 147 && n < 190 )); then
    python3 "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit $((20 + local_i))
    local_i=$((local_i + 1))
  fi
  n=$((n + 1))
done < <(git ls-files -z -- ':(glob)**/test-*.py' 'test-*.py' | sort -z -u)
exit 0
